title: Learning partial transpose signatures in qubit ququart states from a few measurements
summary: Higher-dimensional quantum systems are attracting interest for improving quantum protocol performance by increasing memory space. Characterizing quantum resources of such systems is fundamental but experimentally costly. We tackle the first non-trivial example: a qubit-ququart system, focusing on partial-transpose spectral classification. Entanglement distillation extracts maximally entangled states from noisy resources, but determining distillability typically requires full state tomography, experimentally prohibitive for high-dimensional systems.
